In this deeply personal and revealing episode of Let’s Connect, Amir Tsarfati steps off the host’s chair and onto the guest’s sofa to share the untold story of how Behold Israel began. Joined by HT & Tara Novak, and Gale Frank, this conversation traces the miraculous journey from Amir’s military days and early tours to a devastating car accident in the Philippines to divine appointments that shaped the global ministry we know today.

Hear how God used simple moments, faithful friendships, and supernatural provision to build a platform that now reaches millions worldwide with biblical truth about Israel and the Last Days. 

You’ll be inspired by stories of bold obedience, spiritual warfare, and the unmistakable hand of God behind every chapter.

data.raw_text: Philippines 🇵🇭 Severe flooding hit the Camaman-an area of ​​Cagayan de Oro City, Philippines, on June 10, 2025. Heavy rains associated with the southwest monsoon (Habagat) and a low pressure area caused flash floods, submerging streets and residential and commercial areas. Two vehicles, a jeepney and a motorcycle, were swept away by strong currents, and emergency crews carried out rescue operations for trapped residents.

data.raw_text:
[6:41PM] #Masha_Aguda #TrafficUpdate 

Smooth traffic flow on Eric Moore inward and outward journey to Iganmu Bridge and Doyin, with unhindered movement observed on the Eric Moore inward route to Bode Thomas junction.

Uncongested roads along the stretch of Babs Animashaun, facilitating good movement in both inward and outward directions towards Census and Doyin.

Efficient traffic management at Census inward Aiyetoro down to Brown, with signalized traffic light control at NEPA ensuring a smooth flow of traffic.

Good movement observed on various routes, including Aguda to Pako to Ijesha Market, Otun Oba to Lawanson/Ogunlana down to Ojuelegba, Census journey to Agboyin/Adelabu to Kilo down to Nnobi, and Onilegogoro to Masha with a similarly smooth return journey.

Unimpeded traffic flow on Ogunlana to Cele Okota link bridge inward Cele service lane and Oshodi Expressway, with both routes operating in good order.

#FollowLASTMA
